primary_meaning: Victory, triumphant conquest, or the advance of Christ/the gospel

alternatives.meaning: The Antichrist or a false/deceptive conqueror (especially the first seal)
basis: contrast with the rider of Revelation 19
symbolic use of white throughout Scripture

alternatives.meaning: General divine judgment, military power, or one of the four horsemen of apocalypse

notes: The white horse of Revelation 19 is almost universally identified with the returning Christ; the white horse of the first seal (Revelation 6) remains disputed between Christ/gospel and Antichrist/conquest views. White color symbolism of purity/victory is stable across Christian tradition, but no single meaning covers every occurrence without debate.
